infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TrailLink shows your position on the trail map and shares it with your ride group.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: TrailLink keeps sharing your position with your ride group while your phone is in your pocket or the screen is off.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: TrailLink uses the camera to scan a ride's QR code so you can join the group.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: TrailLink uses Bluetooth to swap positions with nearby riders and to talk to your vehicle's mesh radio when there is no cell signal.
